items:
Flamingo Key
A Block to the Gulf with Private Pool + In-Law Apartment

Home Introduction
Flock to Flamingo Key! Just a 2-minute walk from door to sand at the Greenwood Beach Entrance, this spacious 6-bedroom retreat is perfectly designed for large families and groups looking to stay close to the Gulf. With a private pool, flexible in-law apartment, and refreshed interiors for 2026, this 30A escape offers the ideal blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm.

Home Highlights
- Updated for 2026 — New kitchen, new living room furniture, fresh paint, and refreshed landscaping
- Private Pool (24x12) with sun shelf + in-pool loungers — Heated October–April for an additional fee
- Spacious In-Law Apartment — Private entrance, kitchenette, 2 bedrooms + additional sleeping space (sleeps up to 6)
- Pet Friendly — Pre-approval + non-refundable fee required (up to 2 dogs, 60 lbs or less)
- Renovated Full Kitchen — Stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, pantry
- Dining for 14 — Table seating for 10 + breakfast bar seating for 4
- Screened Front Porch — Cushioned sectional + dining table for 4
- Covered Balcony — Rocking chairs + Adirondack seating
- Fenced and Landscaped Backyard — Lounge seating + outdoor dining area
- Outdoor Grill + Enclosed Outdoor Shower
- 6 Taxi Bikes
- Parking for 4 Vehicles (No RVs, trailers, or street parking permitted per HOA)
- Two Full Baths on 1st Floor (One in apartment + one off living room)
- 2nd Floor Laundry Center — Washer and Dryer
- Separate Temperature Controls for each floor + apartment
- Cable + WIFI Throughout Home
- Concierge Services Available — Beach chairs, grocery delivery, baby gear, golf carts, bike rentals, private chef
- Complete Clean Linen Program — All linens laundered after every stay

Sleeping Arrangements
6 Bedrooms | 4 Baths | Sleeps 18
- 2nd Floor King Suite 1 — TV, walk-in closet, sitting area, renovated ensuite bath with walk-in shower (bench, rain + spa shower heads)
- 2nd Floor Queen Suite — TV, dresser storage, ensuite access to shared bath with shower/tub combo
- 2nd Floor Bunk Suite — Two Double-over-Double bunks (sleeps 6), TV, shared bath access with shower/tub combo
- 1st Floor King Guest Room (In-Law Apartment) — Adjacent full bath with shower/tub combo
- 1st Floor Guest Room 1 (In-Law Apartment) — Two Queen beds (sleeps 4), adjacent full bath with shower/tub combo
- 1st Floor Guest Room 2 — Twin daybed + twin trundle (sleeps 2), private door, TV; walk-through access to in-law apartment; nearby full bath with walk-in shower

Location Perks
- 2-Minute Walk to Greenwood Beach Entrance
- 3-Minute Bike Ride to Surfing Deer and Seagrove Village Market
- 5-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside shopping, dining and the famous Seaside Food Trucks
- Quick access to 30A’s best coastal dining, shopping, and beach access points

Know Before You Go
- A mid-stay clean is required for reservations 10+ days (included in rate)
- Pool heat available October–April for an additional fee
- HOA prohibits RVs, trailers, and street parking
- Concierge services available for add-ons including beach chair setups, grocery delivery, and private chef experiences
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
